title: Shrimp and Pilaf Italian Skillet
description: A flavorful and easy Italian-inspired dish made with succulent shrimp and crispy pilaf. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 2-3 minutes per side. Set aside.
In the same skillet, add the pilaf and cook until lightly toasted, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the eastern, middle, and piquant to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked shrimp back into the skillet and stir to combine with the pilaf mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve immediately.
Optional: serve with a squeeze of lemon juice and a side of garlic bread.
